high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a YouTube video page from DW News, a German public broadcast service. The video's title is "What roles could AI actors fill?" and it was posted one day ago with 63K views. The channel has 6.02M subscribers. At the top of the screen, there is a tweet by Eline Van der Helden (@elinehq) that reads: "I see AI not as a replacement for people, but as a new tool - a new paintbrush. Just as animation, puppetry, or CGI opened fresh possibilities without taking away from live acting." This tweet is dated
